events.name: Australia v England — Fifth T20 International
events.selectedSentence: Canberra is the eighth Australia–England white-ball match in 20 days and the last chance to settle what the series became.
events.fullSpiel: The Manuka Oval finale closes three ODIs and five T20s played in a compressed run across the country. It may decide the T20 trophy or resolve a dead rubber, but it always completes the persistent questions of adaptation, squad depth and which match-ups survived repeated venue changes.
